response.sql: WITH station_avgs AS (SELECT t.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescopes t WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(station_avg) as baseline_value FROM station_avgs), above_baseline AS (SELECT sa.station_avg, sa.station_avg - b.baseline_value as excess FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE sa.station_avg > b.baseline_value) SELECT AVG(station_avg) as mean_of_above_baseline_averages, AVG(excess) as mean_excess_above_baseline FROM above_baseline;
